how: docs/steps/step-4b/probes: image t3flare-probe4b (node 24 bookworm arm64; @agentclientprotocol/claude-agent-acp 0.106.0 with claude 2.1.322 from npm; @opencode/cli 2.2.7 from npm); keyhost4b sidecar = computer.internal (key route, key only in its env) + CONNECT logger + the hostile repo's logging host (:8081); acp-client.mjs speaks ACP as t3's adapter does (no client fs, no client terminal); protocol logs in docs/steps/step-4b/out/ (not committed)

P1.noLogin: initialize answers authMethods [] (the managed apiKeyHelper hides login), no authenticate call, no prompt on stderr
P1.modes: with the managed file: currentModeId default, availableModes [default, acceptEdits, plan] (no auto, no bypassPermissions)
P1.bearer: Commissary accepts Claude Code's requests (x-api-key and Bearer from the helper, its anthropic-beta headers): no CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_EXPERIMENTAL_BETAS needed

toolTurns.gpt-6-luna: completed: Write asked; its command was read-only (cat), which Claude Code runs without asking
toolTurns.gemini-3.x: refused by Commissary's upstream for every client (410 deprecated, 403 access disabled, 402 balance): not a Claude Code limit

P1.modelSelection: managed `availableModels` lists catalog ids; `session/set_config_option` model=<catalog id> selects one. Commissary validates on set: an id it refuses fails the set with -32603 (t3: AcpModelSelectionError) and the session stays on `default`. Decision: Claude lists the whole catalog (§3.4's first fallback holds)
P1.grants: one per process with CLAUDE_CODE_API_KEY_HELPER_TTL_MS=24h, across two prompts and a model switch
P1.scrub: CLAUDE_CODE_SUBPROCESS_ENV_SCRUB=1 in 2.1.322 isolates every Bash command with bubblewrap AND plants empty decoy files in the cwd (.env*, package.json, package-lock.json, yarn.lock, pnpm-lock.yaml, bunfig.toml, .npmrc, .yarnrc*, .gitmodules, node_modules/.bin, .claude/.cc-writes) that it leaves behind: an empty package.json and .gitmodules in a user's repo. Decision: scrub off (0, pinned in managed env); the nonce rides in the managed apiKeyHelper command (`T3FLARE_MODEL_KEY_NONCE=<n> t3flare-model-key claude`) written by the launcher, and the launch environment has no nonce. Bash sees nonce-seen=0; the helper sends it (keyhost logs it)
P1.marker: claude-agent-acp and its claude child both carry T3FLARE_EXEC (procwatch)
P1.approvalOptions: Claude offers allow_always ('allow-with-updates', 'allow-skill-exact') even with allowManagedPermissionRulesOnly: the flavor must never offer acceptForSession

P2.provider: providers.t3flare: package @opencode/ai/providers/anthropic-compatible, settings.baseURL <MODEL_PROXY_URL>/v1 (the /v1 is needed), models by real catalog id
P2.keyHook: (a) holds: a server plugin in /etc/opencode/plugins/t3flare-key (plain `export default { id, setup }`, no package import) runs the helper once and sets x-api-key through ctx.provider.transform on provider t3flare only; it deletes the nonce from process.env first (bash: nonce-seen=0; /proc/<pid>/environ keeps it, changelog F10). No relay needed
P2.modelSelection: session/set_config_option model=t3flare/<id>; ACP modes are absent, the agent is config option `mode` (build, plan)
P2.processes: `opencode acp` runs a private `opencode serve --stdio --port 0` child (listening on 127.0.0.1:<random>) that dies with it. Any other subcommand (`opencode debug …`) starts the shared background service `opencode serve --service`, which outlives it: the argv allowlist is `opencode acp` exactly
P2.configWarnings: an invalid statement is dropped and logged to $XDG_DATA_HOME/opencode/log/opencode.log as `level=WARN message="configuration normalization diagnostic" source=/etc/opencode/opencode.json`; unknown keys are silent. The launcher watches the log and kills the process on a diagnostic whose source is ours; the unit test validates the generated file against the schema

P3.claudeDefaults: api.anthropic.com x7 (feature flags, telemetry, WebFetch preflight) beside the proxy; mode auto (WebFetch ran without asking: changelog F4)
P3.claudeProfile: the proxy's host only, plus example.com (the WebFetch the prompt asked for, which asked first)
P3.opencodeProfile: the proxy's host only, plus example.com (asked first)
P3.note: on the probe's internal network the proxy variables are the only route out, so the P3 profile run does not pin them empty; in a Container egress is computer's

P4.verdict: pass (CLI half); the t3-adapter half is M2/M3's replay tests through our flavors
P4.claudeHostile: every Write and every non-read Bash asked; repo allow rules, defaultMode bypassPermissions, hooks (SessionStart, PreToolUse), .mcp.json + enableAllProjectMcpServers, project env (ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL, HTTPS_PROXY, NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS, Bedrock switches, ANTHROPIC_CUSTOM_HEADERS, ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN), the agent with permissionMode (not loaded: 'no agent type named helper'), the skill's inline ! block (not run), settings.local.json: all without effect. Logging host: no request. Proxy: every model call
P4.claudePlan: plan mode: Claude writes its plan file into CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR/plans without asking (Container-local) and edits nothing else; ExitPlanMode arrives as kind switch_mode with options exit-plan-default (allow_once), exit-plan-clear-accept-edits and exit-plan-accept-edits (allow_always), reject. reject: the prompt ends stopReason cancelled. allow_once (t3's accept): mode default and Claude goes on to implement in the same turn (changelog F1)
P4.claudeEnterPlan: EnterPlanMode runs without asking and moves the mode to plan (a drift to plan, which the guard allows)
P4.claudeGoalCompact: /goal answers 'can't run while hooks are restricted (allowManagedHooksOnly)'; /compact compacts (a tool 'Compact conversation'). Decision: idle compaction locked off for these instances (no Container starts for it)
P4.opencodeHostile: edits and shell asked despite repo permissions [*,*,allow] and build/plan/general overrides (system agent rules win); repo subagents (config and .opencode/agents) blocked by tool.use subagent policy; repo provider override and provider evil unused; plugin x.ts not loaded; MCP, formatter and LSP commands not run; no marker; logging host silent
P4.opencodePlan: mode plan: no edit, no request
P4.opencodeAlways: `always` saves a durable rule in opencode.db's permission table: the next process (same data) ran `touch e2.txt` without asking. The flavor offers once and reject only; the snapshot never carries a saved rule

P5.verdict: pass (local); computer's mount on step4b is M4
P5.claude: fresh CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR with only projects/ linked to the synced directory: session/load and session/resume recall the code word, also with the JSONL's last line cut in half
P5.opencode: VACUUM INTO snapshot copied into a fresh data directory: session/load and session/resume recall the code word
P5.leak: no key fragment or nonce in the synced directory or the protocol logs
P5.note: Claude writes auto memory under projects/<cwd>/memory, which syncs with the sessions

P7.verdict: local half: sizes and memory; the amd64 image and cold start on step4b are M1
P7.layers: claude layer 633 MB (claude 326 MiB + the SDK and its deps; only the glibc binary is installed); opencode layer 796 MB because npm installs both cli-linux-arm64 and cli-linux-arm64-musl (243 + 242 MiB). The image takes OpenCode from its release tarball (one binary)
P7.turn: npm ci && npm test: Claude 4.5 s, OpenCode 5.9 s

P8.fork: both agents answer session/fork at protocol 1 (claude-agent-acp: sessionId, modes, configOptions; opencode: sessionId, configOptions); the fork recalls the parent's context. t3's ACP adapter reports canForkThread false; enabling it is a flavor change (forkFromTurn) left to SPI-1037
